note: Illustrative footage for the landing page. Prompts and specs: docs/cinematic/SCENES.md. The page probes each 'base' for .webm/.mp4 (video) and .jpg (still/poster); a scene with neither is skipped. 'window' is in landing chapter units (chapter index + progress). Modes: 'plate' covers the live world; 'handoff' plays once, then dissolves into the live world; 'inline' is placed by its own section.

scenes.name: First Light
scenes.role: Hero opening film over the lunar south pole; dissolves into the live measured Moon.

scenes.name: The Twin
scenes.role: Chapter 1 opening: the Earth stand-in, framed like the Moon shot; hands off to the live probe.

scenes.name: Shadow Tide
scenes.role: Chapter 2 opening: a polar day in time-lapse; hands off to the live plateau and the draggable Sun.

scenes.name: Through the Dust
scenes.role: Passage from the Moon to Mars.

scenes.name: Delta at Dusk
scenes.role: Chapter 3: Jezero at sunset, pure cinema.

scenes.name: The Procession
scenes.role: Chapter 3 close: dust devils, the atmosphere no Earth twin has.

scenes.name: The Pointing
scenes.role: Opens the Same Ground chapter: a hand points at Mars and the map answers with Earth.

scenes.name: Ten Thousand Grounds
scenes.role: Chapter 4 opening: Earth's deserts at dawn from orbit; hands off to the live fidelity field.

scenes.name: The Bootprint
scenes.role: Chapter 5 opening: vacuum in one image; hands off to the live limits ledger.

scenes.name: First Tracks
scenes.role: Chapter 6 opening: departure; hands off to the live mission planner.

scenes.name: The Thin Line
scenes.role: Finale: the Moon rising through Earth's atmosphere.
